passages.note: Aye on concurring in the Senate amendment to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, a reconciliation bill covering taxes, border, energy and spending; a multi-subject vote proves direction at most.
passages.actor_quote: Houchin Houchin Republican Indiana IN Aye

passages.note: Her press-release words praise the bill for making 'the Trump tax cuts permanent' and ending taxes on tips and overtime, a tax-cutting side, but they name no main rate and do not separate rung 4 from rungs 3 or 5.
No tax on tips/overtime and relief for seniors are narrow relief (rung 3 clause [b]) but nothing excludes a broader cut, so it shows a side only.
Campaign issue page written in the third person ('Erin believes our government takes too much of your money'; 'working to cut taxes'), so it is characterization, not her own words.

rows.reasoning: Her Aye on H.R. 1 (119th) is a multi-subject reconciliation vote, and her own statements ('makes the Trump tax cuts permanent, ends taxes on tips and overtime'; 'No tax on tips, no tax on overtime') show a tax-cutting side without naming a cut to 'the main rates most people pay' or a call to 'cut taxes as far as possible and shrink what government does'. The campaign issue page is third-person and cannot carry a chair.
needs_source: Her own words (first-person issue page, questionnaire or debate answer) on cutting the main individual income tax rates, or on cutting taxes as far as possible and shrinking government
A single-subject tax bill she authored or prime-sponsored that cuts the main individual income tax rate (congress.gov sponsor page and bill text)

quotes.text: This bill makes the Trump tax cuts permanent, ends taxes on tips and overtime, slashes wasteful spending, secures our border, unleashes American energy, and restores accountability across the federal government.
